[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-9x[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Make bead event-stream merges stable under rebase replay[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Concurrent bead writers in every plans-sidecar clone converge [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]without human intervention: a multi-commit rebase replays to [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]completion, derived bead files stay byte-stable across the Rust and[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Python writers, unpushed bead commits are never discarded, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]recurring sync failure is surfaced as a health signal instead of [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]surfacing as a hand-resolved merge conflict.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase/repos/plans/202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]bead_merge_replay_stability.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Position-independent event identity and replay-stable stream [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]merge[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]merge[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]merge: stop renumbering already-recorded bead events during stream [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]merge, give newly created events collision-free identities, and replace [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the positional append-only check with an order-preserving containment [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]check so a merge result stays a valid ancestor for the next replayed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commit.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Byte-identical JSONL encoding across both store writers[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]encoding[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]encoding: make the Python conflict resolver emit the same UTF-8 JSONL [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bytes as the Rust writer so resolution stops rewriting untouched streams[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with escaped-unicode churn that manufactures spurious merge rejections.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Never discard unpushed bead commits during workspace [/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]preparation[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]safety[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]safety: preserve or explicitly rescue local-only bead commits before a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sidecar clone is cleaned and reset to its upstream branch, so preparing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a workspace cannot silently destroy unpublished bead history.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Eliminate the sticky failure loop that deepens divergence[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]divergence[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]divergence: remove the dirty-worktree integration refusals and add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bounded fetch-rebase-retry on push rejection so a transient sync failure[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stops compounding into a deep multi-commit divergence.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]End-to-end multi-commit replay regression coverage[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]replay[dim] · [dim][/dim]after merge, encoding[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]replay: add fixture-repository regression tests that replay a deep [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]divergence between real clones through the managed sync worker and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]assert the rebase completes, pushes, and converges to identical bytes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Surface recurring bead sync failure as a health signal[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]health[dim] · [dim][/dim]after replay[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]health: classify managed-sync log outcomes and report recurring failure [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and deep divergence through existing bead diagnostics so recurrence is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]detected before it reaches a human as a merge conflict.[/#D7D7AF]
